messages.en: I'm about ready to give up. This question is so hard.
Don't give up just yet. Let's try another way.

senses.en_definition: To launch an attack on an opponent or target.
Of a disease, pest, or similar agent: to affect someone or something, causing illness or damage.
To criticize, blame, or insult someone or something harshly.

messages.en: They've been attacking nonstop. Our team can barely get out of our own half.
Yeah, every time we get the ball, we lose it straight away. We need to stay a bit calmer.
Exactly. Hopefully the coach will make a substitution soon and bring on some fresh legs.
The activities at that camp were so much fun, weren't they? I want to go again!
They really were! I've already asked when the next camp is. Let's sign up together when the time comes.

collocations.en: take part in a volunteer programme

messages.en: Do you want to enter that competition too?
Yeah! I signed up yesterday. Come on, you should sign up too.
